copilot.lede: Kagōunga is shaped together with farmers, artists, musicians, and makers from North Moluccas and beyond. Ten of the many hands behind the movement.

hero.lede: Rooted in Ternate, growing beyond boundaries.

intro.p1a: Kagōunga is a North Maluku company that turns the region's heritage of flavors, materials, and local wisdom into products, experiences, and creative expressions. Founded by
intro.p1b: , Kagōunga creates Popeda Soup, Sensory Candles, Botanical Soaps, Visual Artworks, and Brand Music. Everything is grounded in authenticity, quality, sustainability, and a supply chain rooted in local communities.
intro.p2a: Kagōunga is also a cultural movement, built with the people who make North Maluku what it is: farmers, fishers, nature enthusiasts, hikers, dive clubs, artisans, artists, composers, singers, dancers, photographers, writers, journalists, lighting designers, models, architects, software engineers, and young people of the region. Through
intro.p2b: , we move together, carrying North Maluku's spirit wherever we go.
